125 m = 0.125 km

Step 2: Calculate the relative speed of the train with respect to the man.
Relative speed = Distance / Time
Relative speed = 0.125 km / (10/3600) hr
Relative speed = 0.125 * 360 hr^-1
Relative speed = 45 km/hr

Actual speed of the train = Relative speed - Speed of the man
Actual speed of the train = 45 km/hr - 5 km/hr
Actual speed of the train = 40 km/hr

Final answer: The speed of the train is 40 km/hr.
